tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live job openings worldwide, checked at official employer sources. Returns up to 10 jobs per call with title, company, location, and a jobvetta URL.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details for one job (description, qualifications, salary, metadata) by job_id from search_jobs.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search live job openings across India, checked at official employer sources. India only — non-Indian locations return no results. Returns up to 10 jobs per call with title, company, location, and a jobvetta URL." → after: "Search live job openings worldwide, checked at official employer sources. Returns up to 10 jobs per call with title, company, location, and a jobvetta URL."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
